summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of deferred fields being incorrectly inherited in nested prefetched queries. It introduces a minimal change that seems to resolve the problem without apparent side effects.

issues.description: While the patch resolves the specific issue, there is a risk of behavioral regression if the deferred fields handling logic is not thoroughly understood or if there are other edge cases not covered by the existing tests.
The added comments could be slightly improved for clarity and consistency with the surrounding code.
